name: Switzerland
shortSummary: Switzerland led the European Free Trade Association to a landmark trade and investment pact with India in 2024, committing to substantial investment pledges over 15 years in exchange for tariff reductions.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: TEPA is expected to substantially expand Swiss investment in India over the coming decade.
Swiss pharmaceutical and machinery firms maintain a significant Indian market presence.

recentDevelopments.title: India-EFTA trade agreement signed
recentDevelopments.description: India signed the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement with the European Free Trade Association (Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein), with EFTA committing to a $100 billion investment target over 15 years.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: One of India's most significant trade agreements with European economies, led by Switzerland.

historicalEvents.title: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
historicalEvents.description: India signs a trade and investment agreement with the European Free Trade Association (Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein), with EFTA states committing to a $100 billion investment target over 15 years in exchange for phased tariff cuts.
historicalEvents.impact: One of India's most significant trade agreements with European economies to date.

agreements.name: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.description: Trade and investment agreement between India and the four EFTA states, led by Switzerland.

multilateralRelations.detail: Switzerland led EFTA negotiations with India culminating in the 2024 TEPA.
Switzerland hosts the WEF, a regular venue for high-level Indian economic diplomacy.
